decision.observation: The farmer is outside on the central porch at 8:00 a.m. Saturday; the stairs lead directly down to the farm path.
decision.hypothesis: Descending the stairs and using the clear mailbox-level route east will reach Pelican Town early enough to find Willy at the beach.
decision.memory: Route: central stairs, then east past the mailbox through the bus stop. West of town, take the southeast branch through the fountain square to the southern east–west road; follow it east across the river before turning south. Avoid the wooded area directly south of town.
